sites.meaning: Before BL HomeTop.HomeEnterAsync; request begins, not response completion. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.

Before BL OutGame3D.ChangeEnvironmentAsync(type2); this branch is camera state, not a scene asset await. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.
Before BL OutGame3D.LoadBackgroundSceneAsync. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.

Background scene await returned and IsLoadingScene=false was stored; virtual AfterLoadEnvironmentAsync has not run yet, actors are not guaranteed ready. Keep original ordinary-instruction checkpoint; its own documented register/SP effects still execute normally.

OnDispose already wrote IsEndShaderWarmUp=true; cleanup gate released, not proof shaders succeeded. Keep original ordinary-instruction checkpoint; its own documented register/SP effects still execute normally.
Before HomePageGroup.OnOpenInAsync call, after shader wait gate. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.
Before LoadingManager.Hide call, not proof complete home visibility. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.

After HomeFrontLoadingView.FinishLoading returned; before later HomeTop.ShowInAsync await, not whole-home completion. Keep original ordinary-instruction checkpoint; its own documented register/SP effects still execute normally.
HomeOfficeActors.LoadActorsAsync wrapper entry. Keep original ordinary-instruction checkpoint; its own documented register/SP effects still execute normally.

UniTaskExtensions.GetAwaiter for four-motion join; join examined, not proof it suspended. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.
Before SolisActorUtility.UpdateCacheActorAsync call after cache miss. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.
Cache-hit or successful cache-build merge; actor available before further setup/fade. Keep original ordinary-instruction checkpoint; its own documented register/SP effects still execute normally.
Before UniTask.WaitWhile(cache-busy predicate); not proof waiting duration. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.
HomeCenterPagePresenter.WaitForButtonLoadAsync entry; not button completion. Keep original ordinary-instruction checkpoint; its own documented register/SP effects still execute normally.

HomeTop.ShowInAsync await has returned; next call is NotificationManager.Resume, then separate HomeEntering/tutorial work. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.

Reached only when shader completion flag was false: before UniTask.WaitUntil for IsEndShaderWarmUp. Does not read/write context or flag. Later home_open_begin proves this gate passed. Observe immediately before the final ordinary argument-setting instruction preceding the original unmodified BL.
